d:
United Tigers deliver a dominant performance to storm past Royal Desert Champions with a nine-wicket victory!
Royal Desert Champions struggled to build momentum and were restricted to 81/9 in their 10 overs, with Abbas Afridi leading the bowling attack with an impressive 3/10.
In response, United Tigers made light work of the chase, reaching 84/1 in just 7 overs! Fakhar Zaman smashed an unbeaten 45 off 21 balls, while Joe Clarke chipped in with an unbeaten 25 off just 12 deliveries.
